description: Reference list of recognized internal accounts used in settlement and reconciliation. Any ledger movement to an internal account NOT on this list is unrecognized and must be investigated before close.
note: There is no recognized standing 'suspense' or 'adjustment 9911' account in production settlement. A movement to a suspense/adjustment account with no settlement reference is not a normal daily-close entry and should be treated as an unexplained residual requiring investigation.
